_about: Test notes for the Quartermaster's effects workbook (tools/gh_testsheet.py). turns: the test hand in play order; an entry with "rest" is a long rest for the whole party. picks: the level-up card picks the hand needs. states: what Gloomhaven shows per animator state, where known; the rest is generated from the pack data.
setup: His refresh abilities need spent items: give him and an ally a potion each (Ctrl+F9 for gold) and use them before turns 4 and 7, so there is something to refresh.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 2 next to enemies and shield up (the power-up), then the axe sweep (Attack 2 on the area).
Bottom first: move 3 and push the adjacent enemies with the lightning scroll, then the bow shot (Attack 3, range 3).
turns.setup: Enemies adjacent after the move; one within 3.

turns.order: Bottom first: pull an enemy from range 3 (the targeted scroll), then the plain attack (Attack 3).
Top: refresh a spent item on an ally within 2 (the refresh). Bottom: Move 4.
turns.setup: An ally within 2 who has used an item this scenario.

turns.order: Top: the radial judgment scroll on enemies within 4. Bottom: his ranged attack bonus (the power-up).
Top: the heavy hammer blow (Attack 3). Bottom: Shield 1 on the adjacent allies (the radial buff).
Top: the lightning scroll at an enemy within 3 (Attack 5). Bottom: the bow shot (Attack 1, range 4).
Top: Heal 4 on himself or an adjacent ally. Bottom: pull an enemy from range 3.

states.Attack: A sword swing with his melee attack sound and the weapon impact.
states.HeavyAttack: The heavy two-handed blow with the heavy-attack sound.
states.SlamAttack: The slam: a wide swing over the area with the radial-buff sound (Gloomhaven's own choice of sound for it).
states.RangedAttack: The bow shot (the arrow stands in for Gloomhaven's bolt) with the stand-in's throw sound.
states.Refresh: He reaches into his pack and the ally's item glows, with the refresh-ally sound.
states.TargetedScroll: He reads a scroll and a magic effect hits the target, with the targeted-magic cast sound.
states.TargetedScrollLightning: The scroll's lightning strikes the target, with the targeted-lightning cast sound.
states.RadialScroll: The scroll's magic bursts over the enemies around, with the radial-magic cast sound.
states.RadialScrollLightning: Lightning over the adjacent enemies, with the radial-lightning cast sound.
states.RadialBuff: A ring over the adjacent allies with the radial-buff sound.
states.PowerUp: The cast pose with his power-up sound.
states.Heal: The cast pose with the heal animation.
states.Loot: His loot stoop with the loot sound.

actions.name: Movement
actions.expected: His run cycle with footstep sounds and a dust puff at each footfall.

actions.name: Item use
actions.expected: His item animation with the item-use sound.

actions.name: Taking a hit
actions.expected: Hit reaction with one of three grunts.
